ffmpeg_required:
Module-ka `{{module_name}}` wuxuu u baahan yahay **FFmpeg** inuu shaqeeyo. Fadlan ka rakib bogga rasmiga ah: - [https://ffmpeg.org](https://ffmpeg.org)

Haddii FFmpeg hore loo rakibay, fur terminal cusub, tijaabi `ffmpeg -version`, ka dibna HomeGenie dib uga bilow isla terminalkaas. Haddii aadan u baahnayn sifadan, waxaad curyaamin kartaa module-kan qaybta **Automation Programs**, ama adigoo gujinaya badhanka hoose.
